steps.label: CYCLES
steps.sub: ups and downs, no fixed length

code:
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
idx = pd.date_range("2019-01-01",
    periods=60, freq="MS")
t = np.arange(60)
sales = (200 + 1.5 * t + season
         + rng.normal(0, 4, 60))
s = pd.Series(sales, index=idx)
# season: 12 monthly offsets
caption: True trend: 1.5 per month. Built-in yearly pattern.

code:
res = seasonal_decompose(
    s, model="additive", period=12)

# slope per month: 1.56  (true 1.5)
# December seasonal: +35.1
# trend NaNs: 12 (six at each end)
# residual std: 2.94
caption: Recovered close to what we built in.
Observed, trend, seasonal and residual panels.
